description: The main working tree contains one current state only. For every course, Subject Examination uses every eligible file recursively under Lecture or 01_Lectures, including nested files regardless of names such as Exercise, homework, review, or additional documents. Files whose real filename identifies Week 0 or Week 0.x are excluded completely from the eligible corpus, knowledge/question evidence, source metadata, source references, and Source Panel display. AI builds the maximum number of genuinely distinct Lecture-supported semantic blueprints without a fixed quota, while the shared runtime persistently prevents semantic repetition across refreshes, tabs, and browser sessions and stops before repeating when no unseen semantic blueprint remains.
